title: Establishment of a Novel Flow Cytometric Diagnostic Assay to Effectively Evaluate Immune Reconstitution After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
official: Establishment of a Novel Flow Cytometric Diagnostic Assay to Effectively Evaluate Immune Reconstitution After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
summary:
Primary Objective

To assess immune reconstitution during the first 18 months following hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) for acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), with a particular focus on the T-cell compartment (thymic regeneration and surrogate markers of cytotoxic function), using a dedicated panel developed within the EuroFlow consortium.

Secondary Objectives

To assess the impact of donor and recipient characteristics, graft-versus-host disease (GvHD) prophylaxis, and conditioning regimen on post-transplant immune reconstitution.

To evaluate the correlation between immune reconstitution and the development of complications using unsupervised analysis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who undergo first HSCT for ALL
* Signing of informed consent by the patient (age\>18) or by parent/legal guardian (age \<18)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lack of informed consent
* \>1° HSCT
* ALL with specific genetic backgrounds which may impact on IR such as Down syndrome
